segments.t: In the hallway at ASK, Herve stops Gabriel to make a nervous confession about his secret acting career. However, Gabriel reveals that the secret is already out across the agency. Let's listen to their exchange in French first.
Gabriel, vous avez une minute?
Oui, qu'est-ce qui se passe?
J'ai quelque chose à vous avouer.
Quoi donc? Rien de grave?
Non, mais c'est très délicat.
Allez, parlez, je vous écoute!
J'ai joué un rôle au cinéma.
J'ai tourné dans un vrai film!
Le film de Donzelli? Je sais.
Élise me l'a déjà dit.
Quoi? Ce n'est pas vrai!
Elle devait garder le secret!
Mon Dieu, vous êtes tellement naïf!
On ne peut faire confiance à personne.
Let's examine the conversation line by line and explore the French expressions.
Gabriel, vous avez une minute?
'Gabriel, do you have a minute?' Hervé approaches Gabriel hesitantly and asks if he has a minute to talk.
Oui, qu'est-ce qui se passe?
'Yes, what is going on?' Gabriel stops and gives his assistant his attention.
J'ai quelque chose à vous avouer.
'I have something to confess to you.' Hervé prepares to admit his secret acting job.
Quoi donc? Rien de grave?
'What then? Nothing serious?' Gabriel hopes there is no crisis at the agency.
Non, mais c'est très délicat.
'No, but it is very delicate.' Hervé tries to soften the news before speaking.
Allez, parlez, je vous écoute!
'Come on, speak, I am listening to you!' Gabriel impatiently gestures for him to get to the point.
J'ai joué un rôle au cinéma.
'I played a role in a movie.' Hervé finally reveals his appearance on the big screen.
J'ai tourné dans un vrai film!
'I acted in a real movie!' Hervé emphasizes that it was a legitimate feature production.
Le film de Donzelli? Je sais.
'The Donzelli movie? I know.' Gabriel immediately names the director without surprise.
Élise me l'a déjà dit.
'Elise already told me.' Gabriel explains how the news reached him first.
Quoi? Ce n'est pas vrai!
'What? That is not true!' Hervé is stunned that his confidence was betrayed.
Elle devait garder le secret!
'She was supposed to keep the secret!' Hervé complains that Elise promised not to tell.
Mon Dieu, vous êtes tellement naïf!
'My God, you are so naive!' Gabriel teases Hervé for trusting a rival agency head.
On ne peut faire confiance à personne.
'You cannot trust anyone.' Hervé laments the lack of discretion in the film industry. Now let's listen to the complete discussion once more to reinforce the vocabulary.

Herve realizes to his dismay that his secret acting debut is already common knowledge at ASK. When you watch the episode, listen out for the expressions meaning 'minute' and 'is happening'. You'll catch them now. See you next time!
Au revoir!
